Jaipur wall collapse leaves at least three dead, with 15 labourers trapped

A wall under construction in Jaipur's Amer area collapsed on Tuesday, leaving at least three people dead and 15 labourers trapped under debris. The incident occurred while the workers were working on the site. Rescue efforts are underway to save those trapped. The cause of the collapse is still unknown.
